tasks.title: Add dark mode toggle to settings
tasks.body: Let users switch the app between light and dark themes from the settings page. Persist the choice across sessions.

tasks.title: Implement light/dark theme switcher in preferences
tasks.body: Users should be able to choose a dark or light appearance in preferences and have it remembered when they come back.

tasks.title: Respect the OS dark/light setting by default
tasks.body: On first load, follow the operating system appearance setting until the user explicitly picks a theme.

tasks.title: Fix incorrect proration on plan upgrade
tasks.body: When a user upgrades their subscription mid-cycle the prorated charge is computed wrong. Correct the calculation.

tasks.title: Proration amount is wrong when upgrading a subscription
tasks.body: Upgrading a plan partway through the billing period charges the wrong prorated amount; make the proration correct.

tasks.title: Add welcome tour for new users
tasks.body: Introduce new users to the core features with a short guided tour the first time they sign in.

tasks.title: Build a first-run product walkthrough for new signups
tasks.body: New signups should get a step-by-step walkthrough of the main features on their first session.

tasks.title: Export data
tasks.body: Allow exporting all workspace tasks to a CSV file from the tasks page.

tasks.title: CSV download for tasks
tasks.body: Users need a button to download every task in the workspace as a CSV file.

tasks.title: Allow drag-and-drop file upload to chat
tasks.body: Let users drag a file onto the chat window to attach and upload it to the conversation.

tasks.title: Support dragging files into the chat to attach them
tasks.body: Dropping a file into the chat should attach it and upload it to the current thread.

tasks.title: Fix broken avatar images on profile
tasks.body: Profile avatars intermittently fail to load and show a broken-image icon. Fix the loading.

tasks.title: Profile avatars not loading
tasks.body: Avatar images on the profile page frequently do not render. Investigate and fix.

tasks.title: Group inbox emails by date like Superhuman
tasks.body: Split the inbox into Today, Yesterday, Past 7 days, and older sections, similar to Superhuman.

tasks.title: Restore j/k keyboard navigation for emails
tasks.body: Bring back j/k shortcuts to move the selection up and down the email list.

tasks.title: Use new doppler config: dss
tasks.body: Switch document_storage_service to read configuration from the new doppler project.

tasks.title: Use new doppler config: dcs
tasks.body: Switch document_cognition_service to read configuration from the new doppler project.

tasks.title: Debounce task search input
tasks.body: Debounce the task search box so we don't fire a request on every keystroke.

tasks.title: Improve task search result ranking
tasks.body: Tune the relevance ranking so the most relevant tasks show up first in search.

tasks.title: Add retry with backoff to the SQS consumer in notification_service
tasks.body: Wrap the notification_service SQS consumer with retry and exponential backoff on transient failures.

tasks.title: Add retry with backoff to email sending in email_service
tasks.body: Add exponential backoff retries around the outbound email send path in email_service.

tasks.title: Add mute setting for channel notifications
tasks.body: Let a user mute notifications for a specific channel so they stop getting pinged.

tasks.title: Show unread badge count on channel notifications
tasks.body: Display a numeric unread badge on each channel in the sidebar.

tasks.title: Add Google OAuth login
tasks.body: Let users sign in with their Google account via OAuth.

tasks.title: Add Microsoft OAuth login
tasks.body: Let users sign in with their Microsoft account via OAuth.

pairs.note: Same work (a persisted light/dark theme control), different wording.
Identical bug (wrong proration on upgrade), reworded.
Same deliverable: a guided first-run tour for new users.
Same work stated with terse, different titles; the body carries the signal (CSV export of all tasks).
Same feature: drag-and-drop file attach in chat.
Same bug: profile avatars fail to load.
Both touch the email list and reference Superhuman, but one is date grouping and the other is keyboard navigation.
Both about task search, but debouncing input vs. ranking relevance are different actions.
Both about channel notifications, but muting vs. showing an unread badge are different deliverables.
Same action (adopt new doppler config) but in two different services; distinct work assigned to different areas.
Same pattern (retry with backoff) applied to different subsystems (SQS consumer vs. email send).
Same action (OAuth login) against different identity providers; separate integrations.
